title: Kristiansten Fortress

buildingCutout.basis: Mapped masonry outline of the Donjon at the centre of the fortress.

terrainReference.basis: Original elevation near the foot of the Donjon on its west side.

mapIdentity.scope: Native building footprints 17693566, 89642573, 474662465 and 95714848, mapped retaining-wall ways, exact public-domain images reviewed alongside Forsvarsbygg’s conservation register, and sampled original hillside elevation.

note: The upper keep is a three-storey white limewashed masonry donjon, with a grey fully hipped slate roof and splayed small openings. Bastion walls are battered rough stone with planted crests. Lower support buildings use white cladding, red tile on the commandant’s residence, and grey roofing on the magazine.
